description: Rename a lead CSV's columns to the fields a sequencer imports (Instantly, Smartlead, EmailBison, or generic snake_case). Every row and column is kept; only the header changes, and columns with no standard field keep a snake_case name for custom variables. Returns the mapping, and the converted CSV when it is 500 rows or fewer.

csv.description: The lead CSV as text, header row first.

name: convert_csv
title: Sequencer CSV converter
